cuts.item: Nine ESSER-funded school positions cut in the level service minus ESSER scenario
Town manager reduced the DPW tree removal budget

statements.statement: The DPW director's needs-based request is above the town manager's preliminary DPW budget.
The school committee voted an override recommendation, later said to be wrong by roughly six hundred thousand because of a hidden cell.
The corrected override figure, level service minus ESSER cuts, was given roughly as about one point three million.
The town manager's preliminary school budget is a 2.94% increase; the needs budget is 5.4% and level service minus ESSER cuts is 8.59%.
Extra money might come to the schools depending on new growth certification, and would come off any override amount.

warnings.condition: possible need to slash the school budget
warnings.prediction: Moving out of TC Pasos could be a way to cut school costs, and Turkey Hill might lack the electricity for the offices.
The town manager does not recommend borrowing for the next few years, which would block large building projects.
